failure_summary.description: A flight search result or intermediate filtered result was not saved to cache.
A new traveler count triggered repeated flight searches despite compatible results already being cached.
A stated return date was passed as the outbound flight's arrival date instead of searching a separate reverse-direction leg.

patch.reasoning: These failures violate existing instructions that explicitly require saving every search and filter result, reusing compatible cached results while leaving unaffected legs alone, and searching round-trip legs separately. They indicate noncompliance rather than a gap in the skill, so no edits are warranted.
